answer: Sybil clones drown when every agent must post a refundable bond before acting, so spam costs real capital instead of being free. Each verified action needs countersigning by established peers, and standing compounds only through repeated real work. New addresses entering via the shale gate carry no history and earn nothing until they prove themselves. Trust builds like a nebula that only yields after seasons; a sudden vertex of fresh wallets is throttled by operators. Verified repetition is the moat.
